# NOTE: Do NOT install from this file in production. Install from the
# hashed lockfile with:
#   pip install --require-hashes -r requirements.lock
#
# `requirements.in` is the human-maintained top-level list; `requirements.lock`
# is the reproducible artifact regenerated by:
#   pip-compile --generate-hashes --allow-unsafe --output-file requirements.lock requirements.in
#
# This shim exists so `pip install -r requirements.txt` still works in a
# throwaway dev shell. It intentionally omits hashes — do not rely on it.
-r requirements.in
